description: The file defines the ContentMapFacade class, a central component within the OFBiz framework for managing content objects, providing map-based access to content properties, related data resources, subcontent, metadata, and rendering functionality.

classes.name: ContentMapFacade
classes.description: Main class implementing a map interface for content management, providing access to content data, subcontent, metadata, data resources, and rendering capabilities. Contains nested classes for content details, subcontent, metadata, and data resource handling.

methods.name: setRenderFlag
methods.description: Sets the flag controlling whether content should be rendered or not.

methods.name: setIsDecorated
methods.description: Marks the instance as decorated, affecting rendering logic.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Defines the order in which subcontent is processed or displayed.

methods.name: setMapKeyFilter
methods.description: Sets filter criteria for subcontent map keys.

methods.name: setStatusFilter
methods.description: Sets filter criteria for content status.

methods.name: setDecoratedContent
methods.description: Assigns a decorated ContentMapFacade for rendering.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Main method retrieving various content-related data or control objects based on key strings such as 'fields', 'link', 'data', 'subcontent_all', etc.

methods.name: renderThis
methods.description: Renders the content as a String if rendering is allowed, including safety checks to prevent infinite recursion.
